title: ART null-receiver invoke NPE law (all 5 instance-invoke paths)
statement: ART throws NullPointerException when invoke-virtual/super/direct/interface/range executes on a null receiver. MiniAndroid previously executed these silently (F-075 missed NULL_REF), letting poison flow until unrelated crashes. Root-caused and fixed S72-W3; the six null-producer laws (Runtime singleton, boxed-reader family, FragmentManager subset, View.getResources, getTheme/resolveAttribute, String.getClass) closed with it.
test: fixtures 25/25 rc=0 zero f141-throws; dooz 197->23472 px progression at the time; unote theme regression recovered
notes: CLOSED unless new evidence directly reopens it (taskbook §35). F-146/F-147 are DISTINCT open blockers, not F-141 regressions.
